tiles.name: Mission Control (Start)
tiles.effect: Passing or landing awards +50 Mission Funds for habitat upgrades.
tiles.citation: NASA Johnson Space Center Mission Control Center.

tiles.topic_zh: 生命维持：舱内大气与氧气

card.title: Air is More Than Oxygen
card.title_zh: 空气不只是氧气：成分与气压
card.one_liner: Astronauts breathe normal sea-level pressure air with 21% oxygen, not pure oxygen!
card.one_liner_zh: 宇航员呼吸的空气气压与地球海平面相同（14.7 psia），氧气只占 21%，不能呼吸纯氧！
card.why_it_matters: Pure oxygen creates extreme flammability fire hazards (like Apollo 1), while wrong pressure causes decompression sickness or hypoxia.
card.why_it_matters_zh: 纯氧会导致极易发生剧烈火灾（如阿波罗 1 号悲剧），气压过低则会导致减压病或缺氧。
card.how_nasa_does_it: The International Space Station and Artemis base maintain 101.3 kPa (14.7 psia) with 78% nitrogen and 21% oxygen.
card.how_nasa_does_it_zh: 国际空间站和阿尔忒弥斯基地均维持 101.3 kPa（14.7 psia）的总压，由 78% 氮气与 21% 氧气组成。
card.citation: NASA Advanced Oxygen Generation & NASA-STD-3001 Vol 2.

quiz.question: What is the standard atmospheric pressure and oxygen percentage maintained inside the International Space Station?
quiz.question_zh: 国际空间站（ISS）舱内维持的标准总气压与氧气体积百分比是多少？
quiz.hint: It is identical to normal Earth sea-level conditions!

options_explorer.text: 14.7 psia with about 21% oxygen (same as Earth sea level)
options_explorer.text_zh: 约 14.7 psia 且氧气占约 21%（与地球海平面相同）

options_commander.text: 14.7 psia (101.3 kPa) with ~21% O2 and ~78% N2
10.2 psia (70.3 kPa) with 34% O2 and 66% N2
8.3 psia (57.2 kPa) with 100% pure O2
16.0 psia (110.3 kPa) with 50% O2 and 50% N2

quiz.explanation: NASA-STD-3001 mandates 14.7 psia (101.3 kPa) total pressure with 21% oxygen and 78% nitrogen for long-duration habitats to ensure physiological comfort and fire safety.
quiz.explanation_zh: NASA-STD-3001 标准规定长期居住舱维持与地球海平面一致的 14.7 psia（101.3 kPa）及 21% 氧气，以兼顾生理健康与防火安全。

tiles.topic_zh: 生命维持：水循环与回收闭环

card.title: Every Drop Recycled
card.title_zh: 每一滴水都要回收：98% 循环率
card.one_liner: NASA can now recycle 98% of all water on the space station, including breath condensate and sweat!
card.one_liner_zh: NASA 在国际空间站上已经能回收 98% 的水，宇航员呼出的水汽和汗水全都能净化为纯净饮用水！
card.why_it_matters: Water weighs 1 kg per liter; launching years worth of drinking water from Earth would bankrupt any deep space mission.
card.why_it_matters_zh: 水每升重 1 公斤，如果所有饮用水都从地球发射，飞船会因太重而无法完成深空探索。
card.how_nasa_does_it: The ECLSS Water Recovery System on the ISS achieved a 98% recovery milestone in 2023 using distillation and brine processing.
card.how_nasa_does_it_zh: 2023 年，ISS 的 ECLSS 系统通过真空蒸馏和卤水回收组件（BPA）正式实现了 98% 的水回收里程碑。
card.citation: NASA (2023). NASA Achieves Water Recovery Milestone on International Space Station.

quiz.question: What percentage of water does NASA's advanced ECLSS system recover and purify back into potable drinking water?
quiz.question_zh: NASA 空间站先进生命维持系统（ECLSS）目前能把多少比例的水净化回收为饮用水？

options_commander.text: 98% (achieved via the Urine Processor and Brine Processor Assembly)
options_commander.text_zh: 98%（通过尿液处理器与卤水处理器 BPA 实现）

options_commander.text: 93% (limited by reverse osmosis membrane fouling)
options_commander.text_zh: 93%（受限于反渗透膜污染）

options_commander.text: 88% (with 12% lost to metabolic consumption)
options_commander.text_zh: 88%（12% 因代谢消耗损失）

options_commander.text: 100% (zero water loss under any operational condition)
options_commander.text_zh: 100%（任何工况下均零水损耗）

quiz.explanation: In 2023, NASA officially announced that ECLSS on ISS reached the critical 98% water recovery milestone required for crewed Mars transit missions.
quiz.explanation_zh: 2023 年，NASA 正式宣布国际空间站水回收系统突破 98% 门槛，这达到了人类载人前往火星的最低生命保障要求。

tiles.name: Situation Wheel Event
tiles.effect: Immediately triggers a Situation Wheel event with an engineering trade-off.
tiles.citation: NASA Exploration Systems Development Mission Directorate.

tiles.topic_zh: 生命维持：二氧化碳隐形杀手与限值

card.title: The Silent Hazard: CO2
card.title_zh: 隐形杀手：二氧化碳分压限值
card.one_liner: Even if you have plenty of oxygen, exhaled CO2 will cause severe headaches and confusion if it passes 3 mmHg!
card.one_liner_zh: 哪怕氧气充足，如果呼出的二氧化碳浓度超过 3 mmHg，人也会头痛欲裂、思维迟钝！
card.why_it_matters: In microgravity or closed habitats, exhaled CO2 forms stagnant pockets around sleeping crew unless ventilation and scrubbers run 24/7.
card.why_it_matters_zh: 在密闭舱内，呼出的 CO2 极易在人周围滞留积聚，必须靠通风与净化器 24 小时不停运转。
card.how_nasa_does_it: NASA sets the Spacecraft Maximum Allowable Concentration (SMAC) nominal target to below 3.0 mmHg (0.4 kPa) using regenerative amine scrubbers.
card.how_nasa_does_it_zh: NASA 将航天器最高允许浓度（SMAC）目标设在 3.0 mmHg（约 0.4 kPa）以下，采用可再生胺树脂吸附净化。
card.citation: Law, J. et al. (2015). Spacecraft Maximum Allowable Concentrations (SMAC) for Carbon Dioxide. NASA NTRS 20150021777.

quiz.question: What is NASA's operational safe ceiling for carbon dioxide partial pressure in astronaut habitats to prevent headaches?
quiz.question_zh: 为了防止宇航员头痛和认知能力下降，NASA 规定的舱内二氧化碳分压安全上限是多少？
quiz.hint: Normal Earth atmospheric CO2 is less than 0.3 mmHg; NASA limits spacecraft to under 3.0 mmHg.

options_commander.text: Nominal < 3.0 mmHg (0.4 kPa); SMAC 24-hour limit at 5.0 mmHg
options_commander.text_zh: 标称 < 3.0 mmHg (0.4 kPa)；SMAC 24 小时应急限值为 5.0 mmHg

options_commander.text: Nominal < 7.6 mmHg (1.0 kPa); SMAC 24-hour limit at 15.0 mmHg
options_commander.text_zh: 标称 < 7.6 mmHg (1.0 kPa)；SMAC 24 小时应急限值为 15.0 mmHg

options_commander.text: Nominal < 0.3 mmHg (same as pristine sea level air)
options_commander.text_zh: 标称 < 0.3 mmHg（与洁净海平面空气完全一致）

options_commander.text: Nominal < 12.0 mmHg (1.6 kPa)
options_commander.text_zh: 标称 < 12.0 mmHg (1.6 kPa)

quiz.explanation: Studies published in NTRS 20150021777 showed astronauts reported headaches when CO2 rose above 3-4 mmHg. NASA-STD-3001 enforces an operational ceiling below 3.0 mmHg.
quiz.explanation_zh: NASA NTRS 报告证实，当 CO2 分压升至 3-4 mmHg 以上时宇航员即会出现头痛症状，因此 NASA 标准将长期限值卡在 3.0 mmHg。

tiles.topic_zh: 辐射防护：太阳粒子事件与屏蔽

card.title: Shielding From Solar Particle Events
card.title_zh: 太阳风暴与月面辐射防护
card.one_liner: The Moon has no global magnetic field or atmosphere to block cosmic rays, so astronauts must hide in shielded shelters!
card.one_liner_zh: 月球既没有全球磁场也没有大气层保护，太阳爆发风暴时宇航员必须躲进厚重屏蔽层！
card.why_it_matters: A major Solar Particle Event (SPE) can deliver over 1000 mSv of radiation, causing acute radiation poisoning without protection.
card.why_it_matters_zh: 一次特大太阳粒子事件在开阔月面上可产生超过 1000 mSv 的致命辐射，若无掩体将导致急性辐射病。
card.how_nasa_does_it: NASA uses lunar regolith berms (1.5-2 m thick) and water tanks surrounding sleep quarters, limiting career dose to under 600 mSv.
card.how_nasa_does_it_zh: NASA 规划用 1.5 到 2 米厚的月壤袋和环形水箱包围核心宿舍，将职业生涯总累积剂量控制在 600 mSv 以内。
card.citation: NASA Space Radiation Analysis Group (SRAG) FAQ & OCHMO Radiation Brief.

quiz.question: What is NASA's standard career radiation exposure limit for astronauts across all missions?
quiz.question_zh: NASA 规定的宇航员全职业生涯总累积辐射安全限值是多少？
quiz.hint: Earth radiation workers are limited to 5 rem (50 mSv) per year; NASA sets a career cap around 60 rem.

options_commander.text: 600 mSv uniform career limit (based on 3% Mean Risk of Exposure Induced Death)
options_commander.text_zh: 600 mSv 统一终身限值（基于 3% 诱发死亡平均风险）

options_commander.text: 1,000 mSv for men, 800 mSv for women
options_commander.text_zh: 男性 1,000 mSv，女性 800 mSv

options_commander.text: 50 mSv annual limit with no career cap
options_commander.text_zh: 每年 50 mSv，不设终身上限

options_commander.text: 300 mSv for lunar missions, 1,500 mSv for Mars missions
options_commander.text_zh: 月球任务 300 mSv，火星任务 1,500 mSv

quiz.explanation: In 2021, NASA OCHMO standardized the career radiation limit to a universal 600 mSv effective dose for all astronauts regardless of age or gender.
quiz.explanation_zh: 2021 年起，NASA 首席医疗官（OCHMO）将男女所有年龄段宇航员的终身累积辐射限值统一规定为 600 mSv（毫希沃特）。

tiles.name: Supply Depot
tiles.effect: Grants emergency logistical package: +30 kg Materials, +15 Food Rations.

tiles.topic_zh: 电力系统：14 个地球日的漫长月夜

card.title: Surviving the 336-Hour Lunar Night
card.title_zh: 度过 336 小时的极寒长夜：为什么要储能
card.one_liner: A single lunar night lasts about 14 Earth days, and temperatures plummet to -173°C!
card.one_liner_zh: 月球的一个黑夜长达 14 个地球日（336 小时），气温骤降至 -173°C，太阳能板完全无法发电！
card.why_it_matters: Without massive energy storage or nuclear power, heaters and life support freeze and shut down within hours.
card.why_it_matters_zh: 若没有大规模电池储能或核裂变电源，加热器和生命支持系统会在几小时内被彻底冻结断电。
card.how_nasa_does_it: NASA STMD is developing a 40 kWe Fission Surface Power reactor and regenerative fuel cells to provide continuous power through the night.
card.how_nasa_does_it_zh: NASA 正研发 40 kWe 级的月面核裂变电源系统（Fission Surface Power）及再生燃料电池，以解决长夜电力。
card.citation: NASA Science Moon Facts & STMD Fission Surface Power Project.

quiz.question: How long does a continuous lunar night last on most parts of the Moon's surface?
quiz.question_zh: 在月球表面的绝大多数地区，一个连续的黑夜相当于地球上的多长时间？
quiz.hint: The Moon's complete day-night rotation cycle takes about 27 to 29 Earth days.

options_explorer.text_zh: 大约 14 个地球日（336 小时）
大约 12 小时（与地球相同）

options_commander.text: Approximately 14 Earth days (roughly 336 to 354 hours of darkness)
options_commander.text_zh: 约 14 个地球日（约 336 至 354 小时的完全黑暗）

options_commander.text: Exactly 24 hours due to tidal locking
options_commander.text_zh: 因潮汐锁定为固定的 24 小时

options_commander.text: 6 months of total light followed by 6 months of dark
options_commander.text_zh: 6 个月完全日照，随后 6 个月完全黑暗

options_commander.text: 28 Earth days of darkness with no daytime
options_commander.text_zh: 整整 28 个地球日全黑无白昼

quiz.explanation: Because the Moon's rotation is tidally locked to its ~27.3 day orbital period around Earth, daylight and darkness each last approximately 14 Earth days (336 hours).
quiz.explanation_zh: 由于月球自转与公转周期同步（约 27.3 个地球日），月面任意固定点的一个白昼和一个黑夜各长达约 14 个地球日。

tiles.topic_zh: 太空农业：在失重与月球种植食物

card.title: Fresh Food in Deep Space
card.title_zh: 太空农场：Veggie 与植物培养箱
card.one_liner: Astronauts on the ISS grow fresh red romaine lettuce and radishes inside the Veggie chamber using red and blue LEDs!
card.one_liner_zh: 宇航员在空间站用红蓝 LED 灯和水培枕成功种出了红萝蔓生菜和水萝卜！
card.why_it_matters: Prepackaged food loses vitamins C and B1 over 2-3 year missions; fresh crops provide vital nutrients and essential psychological comfort.
card.why_it_matters_zh: 包装宇航食品存放 2-3 年后维生素会大量降解，新鲜植物能补充营养并极大缓解宇航员的心理压力。
card.how_nasa_does_it: NASA's Vegetable Production System (Veggie) and Advanced Plant Habitat (APH) use controlled clay pillows and LED lighting banks.
card.how_nasa_does_it_zh: NASA 的 Veggie 和 APH 植物箱采用缓释肥基质枕和特定光谱 LED，在微重力下精确控制水与养分输送。
card.citation: NASA Science: Vegetable Production System (Veggie) on the International Space Station.

quiz.question: What was the first fresh produce grown and consumed by astronauts aboard the International Space Station in the Veggie unit?
quiz.question_zh: 宇航员在国际空间站 Veggie 植物培养箱中首次成功种植并当场食用的新鲜农作物是什么？
quiz.hint: It is a crisp red leafy salad green!

options_commander.text: Outredgeous Red Romaine Lettuce (Expedition 44, 2015)
options_commander.text_zh: Outredgeous 品种红萝蔓生菜（第 44 远征队，2015 年）

options_commander.text: Dwarf Russet Burbank Potato
options_commander.text_zh: 矮生爱达荷土豆

options_commander.text: Apogee Dwarf Wheat (Expedition 12)
options_commander.text_zh: 远地点矮秆小麦

options_commander.text: Habanero Chili Pepper (Expedition 66)
options_commander.text_zh: 哈瓦那辣椒（第 66 远征队）

quiz.explanation: On August 10, 2015, Expedition 44 crew members harvested and sampled the first crop of 'Outredgeous' red romaine lettuce grown inside the Veggie facility.
quiz.explanation_zh: 2015 年 8 月 10 日，第 44 远征队宇航员正式收获并食用了在 Veggie 箱中培育的第一批 Outredgeous 红萝蔓生菜。

tiles.name: Deep Space Observatory
tiles.effect: Observe solar activity and deep space nebulae: +15 Astronaut XP.
tiles.citation: NASA Astrophysics & James Webb Space Telescope.

tiles.topic: ISRU & Mining: Water Ice at the Poles
tiles.topic_zh: 采矿与资源利用：月球南极水冰

card.title: Goldmine at the South Pole: Water Ice
card.title_zh: 极区宝藏：永久阴影坑中的水冰
card.one_liner: NASA found water ice frozen in deep craters at the Moon's South Pole that haven't seen sunlight for billions of years!
card.one_liner_zh: NASA 在月球南极数十亿年照不到太阳的极寒撞击坑深处，探明了储量丰富的水冰！
card.why_it_matters: Water can be split into hydrogen and oxygen to produce rocket fuel and breathing air right on the Moon.
card.why_it_matters_zh: 水不仅能喝，还能电解出氢气和氧气，在月球就地制造火箭发射推进剂和呼吸氧。
card.how_nasa_does_it: The LCROSS impact mission in 2009 confirmed ~5.6% water ice by mass in Cabeus crater, paving the way for Artemis III landing site selection.
card.how_nasa_does_it_zh: 2009 年 LCROSS 撞月任务证实卡比厄斯坑月壤含有约 5.6% 质量比的水冰，为阿尔忒弥斯登月区选址定下基调。
card.citation: Colaprete et al. (2010), Science & NASA Moon Water and Ices.

quiz.question: Where is the largest concentration of extractable water ice located on the Moon?
quiz.question_zh: 月球上可开采的水冰主要集中分布在什么区域？
quiz.hint: It must be in deep shadows where the sun never shines and temperatures stay below -200°C.

options_explorer.text: Permanently Shadowed Regions (PSRs) at the poles
options_explorer.text_zh: 南北极区的永久阴影坑（Permanently Shadowed Regions）

options_explorer.text: Sunlit plains near the lunar equator
options_explorer.text_zh: 月球赤道周围的阳光平原

options_engineer.text: Permanently Shadowed Craters at the lunar poles
options_engineer.text_zh: 月球极区的永久阴影撞击坑
静海平原的地下岩层中

options_engineer.text: Inside volcanic lava tubes at the equator only
options_engineer.text_zh: 仅存在于赤道的火山熔岩管道内

options_commander.text: Permanently Shadowed Regions (PSRs) at the lunar South and North poles (e.g., Cabeus, Shackleton)
options_commander.text_zh: 月球南北极的永久阴影区（如卡比厄斯坑、沙克尔顿坑）

options_commander.text: Exclusively in the sunlit central peaks of young impact craters
options_commander.text_zh: 只存在于年轻撞击坑向阳的中央峰顶部

options_commander.text: In hydrated subsurface mantle layers accessible only via deep drilling (>10 km)
options_commander.text_zh: 仅存在于深度大于 10 公里的月幔深部

options_commander.text: Uniformly dispersed across all lunar mare basalts
options_commander.text_zh: 均匀分布在所有月海玄武岩表层

quiz.explanation: Because the Moon has only a 1.5° axial tilt, deep polar craters never receive sunlight. At cryogenic temperatures (-240°C), water ice remains trapped as cold traps for billions of years.
quiz.explanation_zh: 月球自转轴倾角仅 1.5°，极区深坑永远无法照到阳光，在低于 -200°C 的极低温下形成保存数十亿年的水冰冷阱。

tiles.topic_zh: 出舱活动（EVA）：宇航服限制与 7 小时安全法则

card.title: Working in a Personal Spacecraft
card.title_zh: 穿上一艘微型飞船：宇航服的 7 小时法则
card.one_liner: A spacesuit is not just clothing; it is a pressurized human spacecraft that lasts only about 7 hours outside!
card.one_liner_zh: 宇航服不是普通的衣服，它是一艘穿在身上的微型飞船，单次出舱作业时间极限大约只有 7 小时！
card.why_it_matters: Suit battery, oxygen, cooling water, and human stamina are strictly limited. Staying out too long means certain suffocation.
card.why_it_matters_zh: 宇航服背包的电池、氧气、升华升温冷却水和宇航员体能都是有限的，超时将直接导致缺氧窒息。
card.how_nasa_does_it: NASA flight rules mandate a 7.0-hour nominal EVA duration, with a mandatory 30-minute reserve for airlock return and repressurization.
card.how_nasa_does_it_zh: NASA 飞行准则严格规定标准出舱时长为 7.0 小时，并保留至少 30 分钟应急储备气用于返回气闸舱并复压。
card.citation: NASA STEM Artemis Generation Spacesuits Activity & JSC EVA Overview.

quiz.question: What is NASA's standard planned duration limit for a single astronaut spacewalk (EVA) before returning to the habitat?
quiz.question_zh: NASA 规定的单次宇航员标准出舱作业（EVA）安全时长上限大约是几个小时？
quiz.hint: Astronauts work a standard full shift outside: about 7 hours.

options_engineer.text: Around 7 to 8 hours (limited by suit consumables)
options_engineer.text_zh: 约 7 到 8 小时（受宇航服消耗品限制）

options_commander.text: 7.0 hours nominal sortie + 30 minutes emergency ingress margin
options_commander.text_zh: 标准作业 7.0 小时 + 30 分钟应急入舱余量

options_commander.text: 10.0 hours nominal with battery hot-swap
options_commander.text_zh: 10.0 小时（支持野外热插拔电池）

options_commander.text: 4.0 hours due to strict suit CO2 accumulation limits
options_commander.text_zh: 4.0 小时（受限于宇航服 CO2 堆积）

options_commander.text: 12.0 hours provided water sublimation cooling functions
options_commander.text_zh: 12.0 小时（只要水升华冷却器正常工作）

quiz.explanation: NASA EVA timelines are planned for a nominal 7.0-hour sortie. Life support consumables (oxygen bottles, LiOH scrubber/rechargeable amine, battery, water sublimation) are strictly sized for this profile.
quiz.explanation_zh: NASA 出舱日程按标准 7.0 小时规划，背包内的氧气储罐、电池、升华冷却水和吸附剂容量均根据此极限设计。
